safety: No em dashes anywhere (code comments, commit messages, PR bodies, docs); no AI attribution in commits or PRs.
This is NOT the Next.js you know: read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before touching a Next API.
Two-library rule: GSAP owns scroll-driven transforms, Motion owns load and component animation; never both on the same property of the same element.
Read src/components/landing/README.md before changing anything in src/components/landing/.

qaNotes: Turbopack serves stale builds: if a worktree dev server acts stale, kill it and rm -rf .next first. Run only one dev server at a time; port 3000 is the convention.
Motion+ (motion-plus) comes from a private registry. The offline store install covers worktrees; any non-offline install needs the auth in the user-level ~/.npmrc.

prTemplate.verification: two-part: (1) automated checks run with results; (2) a GitHub checkbox list of concrete visual QA steps with exact URLs, viewports, and interactions to try (entrances, scroll behavior, reduced motion, mobile menu). Never 'left to the reviewer'.
